title: School and Community
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use the school's own examples: who gave the land, who helps on open day, which community groups use the field.

skills.key_step: The child names ways a school and its community work together.

floor.prerequisite: Names ways people depend on each other.
floor.question: Give one way people depend on each other.

representations: a web with the school in the middle
steps: Name what the school gives back.
contexts: a church using the school hall

board.do: Draw a school and a village with arrows both ways.
Point at the arrow from the school.
board.say: What does the school give the community?

board.do: Write two examples on each arrow.

misconceptions.ask: Which is an example of the school working with the community?
What can a school give the community?
misconceptions.repair: Ask who votes in the school hall.

misconceptions.ask: Who else in the community can work with the school besides parents?
misconceptions.repair: List visitors to the school this term.

misconceptions.ask: Give a way the community helps the school without money.
misconceptions.repair: Tell how parents built the school fence on a work day.

checks.question: Give one way the community helps a school.
checks.answer: any of: land, labour, funds, security, advice

checks.question: Give one way a school helps its community.
checks.answer: any of: educated learners, use of facilities, clean-ups, health days

skills.key_step: The child explains the benefits of school and community working together and picks strategies that keep it going.

floor.prerequisite: Names ways a school and community work together.
floor.question: Give one way they work together.
floor.answer: any example such as a work day

steps: Name the benefit for the school.
Name the benefit for the community.
Ask: will it keep them working together?

board.say: Will this keep the school and community together?

misconceptions.ask: Who gains when the school and community collaborate?

misconceptions.repair: Ask what happens if no one talks.

misconceptions.ask: How does a community gain from a school?
misconceptions.repair: List community events held at school.

misconceptions.ask: How does an open day help the school and the community work together?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what parents talked about with teachers at the last open day.

checks.question: Give one benefit of collaboration to the community.
checks.answer: any of: better learners, shared facilities, development

checks.question: Give one strategy that keeps collaboration going.
checks.answer: any of: open days, meetings, sharing facilities, joint projects, good communication
